principle: AI executes inside approved campaign policy. Wallace reviews escalations and performance.

campaigns.target_segment: local phone-heavy service businesses in Brentwood, Franklin, Cool Springs, and Nashville
campaigns.goal: Create advice-first conversations that can become demos, referrals, or meetings.
campaigns.message_angle: Local Brentwood high schooler building The Call Taker asks whether missed-call and after-hours capture is a real pain.
qualification_rules: no recent contact or stop condition exists
message can be personalized from public/source info
personalization_rules: use first name only if known from source
never claim Wallace saw a missed call unless recorded
do not include checkout link in first touch
autonomous_actions_allowed: send if Instagram adapter is connected and campaign limits pass
escalation_triggers: asks custom pricing or contract terms
campaigns.next_agent_action: Middle Revenue Agent can research real local accounts and queue policy-checked sends.

campaigns.target_segment: non-sensitive warm leads and replies inside approved policy
campaigns.goal: Move warm leads to demo, meeting, checkout, or clear close-out without manual follow-up drift.
campaigns.message_angle: Continue the existing thread with one clear next step.
qualification_rules: lead is not marked personal_relationship or sensitive
reply can be handled from approved policy
personalization_rules: reference prior context only if recorded
autonomous_actions_allowed: send through connected channel if no escalation
campaigns.next_agent_action: Follow-Up Agent can send non-sensitive policy-passing follow-ups; known warm relationships escalate.

campaigns.target_segment: approved local business and community groups
campaigns.goal: Generate advice, comments, referrals, and market language.
campaigns.message_angle: Advice ask from a local founder, not a sales post.
qualification_rules: post does not pitch checkout or pricing
platform adapter confirms posting is allowed or returns human-confirmation-required
autonomous_actions_allowed: post only if adapter and group policy allow autonomous posting
create lead records from interested replies
campaigns.next_agent_action: Middle Revenue Agent can prepare posts and classify replies; publishing waits for adapter/platform allowance.

campaigns.target_segment: approved source-backed local service leads with public email
campaigns.goal: Build scalable email outreach without spam or unapproved imports.
campaigns.message_angle: Missed calls and after-hours calls leak jobs; The Call Taker captures the caller and next step.
personalization_rules: mention business category, not fake observation
unsubscribe/suppression compliance handled by provider policy
autonomous_actions_allowed: import approved list if policy allows
start campaign if policy and adapter allow
campaigns.next_agent_action: Middle Revenue Agent can prepare campaign/list locally; send/start waits on Instantly adapter.
